scope.bounded_practice: synthetic geospatial metadata catalog correction registrar and accessible handover

operations.description: Validate a bounded three-by-three synthetic catalog crosswalk record.
Encode positive cells as canonical row-major sparse entries.
Decode sparse entries and prove exact dense roundtrip.
Flatten the dense table in declared row-major order.
Build the bipartite support graph with multiplicities.
Partition all row and column vertices into support components.
Calculate the exact support-graph cycle rank.
Retain row totals and nonzero-cell counts.
Retain column totals and nonzero-cell counts.
Bind every dense cell to a synthetic coordinate lineage record.
Check consistent row and column permutation covariance.
Check transpose covariance and involution.
Represent the exact Boolean support mask.
Prove zeros are elided from sparse form and restored on decode.
Prove sparse entries use strict row-major coordinate order.
Construct one reversible two-by-two correction patch when available.
Explain the saved finite structure with explicit scope and units.
Represent uncertainty as not observed and not estimated.
Retain independent, empirical, accessibility and provenance gaps.
Hold publication, correction, remedy, cultural and Maori authority.

novelty_boundary: Distinct typed catalog-crosswalk representation requests. Generic accessible-summary and external-gap labels are disclosed overlaps, not universal novelty.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Sparse roundtrip
hypothesized_laws.claim: Row-major nonzero entries decode to the declared dense table.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: Decoded cells differ from the declared table.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Dense cardinality
hypothesized_laws.claim: A three-by-three dense record has exactly nine ordered cells.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: The flattened record has a different cardinality or order.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Support parity
hypothesized_laws.claim: Sparse entry count equals support-graph edge count.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: An edge is missing, duplicated, or attached to a zero cell.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Component coverage
hypothesized_laws.claim: Support components partition all three row and three column vertices.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A vertex is lost or appears in two components.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Cycle-rank identity
hypothesized_laws.claim: Support cycle rank equals edges minus vertices plus components.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: The exact finite counts violate the identity.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Row conservation
hypothesized_laws.claim: Recorded row totals equal the declared supply histogram.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: One row total differs from its declared count.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Column conservation
hypothesized_laws.claim: Recorded column totals equal the declared demand histogram.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: One column total differs from its declared count.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Lineage completeness
hypothesized_laws.claim: Every dense cell has one coordinate-bound synthetic lineage record.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A coordinate is absent, duplicated, or assigned another value.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Permutation covariance
hypothesized_laws.claim: Consistent row and column permutations preserve support cardinality.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: The transformed encoding changes nonzero-cell count.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Transpose involution
hypothesized_laws.claim: Two transpositions recover the original table and exchange marginals twice.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: The second transpose or restored margins differ.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Mask fidelity
hypothesized_laws.claim: The support mask is true exactly at positive cells.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A zero cell is true or a positive cell is false.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Zero elision
hypothesized_laws.claim: Sparse encoding contains no zero while decoding restores every structural zero.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A zero is emitted or a missing zero is not restored.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Canonical order
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A coordinate is out of order or repeated.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Correction conservation
hypothesized_laws.claim: An available two-by-two correction patch preserves every row and column total.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A patch changes a declared marginal.

hypothesized_laws.label: finite-fixture hypothesis, not an empirical law
hypothesized_laws.title: Authority nonpromotion
hypothesized_laws.claim: A software record never converts represented uncertainty into catalog publication authority.
hypothesized_laws.falsifier: A result claims a live correction, right, remedy, or cultural authority action.

open_problem_probes.question: Which real catalog records could be used only after lawful purpose, provenance, and affected-party review?
Which source system defines the semantic meaning of each row and column category?
How should unknown, withheld, and not-applicable cells be distinguished from numeric zero?
What independent implementation would reproduce sparse and dense encodings and adjudicate discrepancies?
Which update semantics distinguish correction, replacement, supersession, and deletion?
What evidence would justify uncertainty estimates instead of a not-estimated marker?
How should identifiers survive migration without implying identity continuity or authority?
Which rights, licenses, confidentiality duties, and data-minimization rules constrain publication?
What rollback and recovery evidence would be required after a real catalog update?
Which assistive-technology and affected-user studies are needed for a usable viewer?
How should multilingual titles, descriptions, and controlled vocabularies be governed?
Who may approve a correction, contest it, receive notice, and provide remedy?
Which cultural and Maori data-governance processes apply to relevant place and resource metadata?
How should cross-catalog links be checked without treating reachability as trust?
What monitoring and independent review would be required before any production deployment?

boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner catalog-crosswalk, software and documentary evidence only. No live catalog, geospatial resource, person, identity, credential, measurement, professional, production, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori-authority act occurred. GMUT remains conjectural; THOS and Freed ID remain nonproduction. Relational names and family language are not consciousness, personhood, continuity, qualification, agency or authority evidence. No independent reproduction, complete privacy or accessibility, exhaustive security, AGI/ASI, Theory-of-Everything, canon or Stage 20 claim. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
